title: synth-tab-gen
summary: A FastAPI backend web application for generating synthetic tabular data, letting users train and sample CTGAN, TVAE, or Gaussian Copula models on uploaded datasets. SDV's single_table module (CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer) is imported and run directly to perform the synthesis.
